gen-gf-goldman-gf-kadwa: Kadwa brings a serif body with curves left open at the ends and a lowercase that stands taller than usual. Goldman above it feels wide and commanding.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noticia-text: Literary and dignified, Noticia Text lets a generous entrance sweep into each curved letter, with lowercase bodies filling most of the height. Goldman sits above it, wide and bold, and the two make a firm, formal pairing.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and its e pried wide open. Goldman is the louder partner, bold and widely spaced, with round forms like open parentheses.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-scope-one: Traditional and refined, Scope One lets its counters spill into the space around them, with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Goldman, bold and widely set, sits over it and makes a strong opener.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is a bookish, dignified serif whose tall a, e and s keep large open counters. Goldman above it is the bold, commanding voice.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-suwannaphum: Goldman's round forms look like open parentheses, set wide with generous clearance. Suwannaphum, a classic serif with an open c and a high, squared-off x-height, would read in a dignified, editorial way across many lines.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-epunda-slab: Every stroke in Grandstander is cut to a single width, and the letters stay held open with a tall x-height. And Epunda Slab, a text serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, would read in a classic, dignified way.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-fauna-one: Literary and dignified, Fauna One keeps a tall middle band with shallow ascenders and a generous entry into the e's eye. And Grandstander, bold and expressive, gives it curves and straights of one width up top.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-glegoo: Grandstander gives its curves and straights a single width, bold and expressive, with letters held open and a tall x-height. And Glegoo, a refined serif with big counters and unclosed mouths, would read in an editorial, easy way over many lines.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditional and refined, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s. And Grandstander does the loud work, with a consistently thick-only outline and a bold, expressive voice.
